episodes.synopsis: Thirteen students in all in Year 10, Class Black. Twelve assassins, one target. The first to kill the target will get whatever they want. As one of the assassins, Tokaku Azuma joins Class Black and begins to size up the competition.
episodes.title: The World Is Full of ___

episodes.synopsis: All 13 students are now assembled and things are about to get serious. But one of them thinks she can jump the gun and beat everyone to the prize.
episodes.title: What Dwells in Your Heart?

episodes.synopsis: Tokaku switches sides to Haru, but the game is still on and the first official Class Black assassination attempt is made.
episodes.title: What's Red, but Isn't Red?

episodes.synopsis: It's three straight days of testing for Class Black. While Haru is intent on passing those tests, another one of the girls is intent on killing her.
episodes.title: What Comes Suddenly and Never Leaves?

episodes.synopsis: Class Black prepares to put on a production of "Romeo and Juliet" for the school festival and another assassin tries her luck.
episodes.title: How Do You Get a Bird Out of Its Cage?

episodes.synopsis: Class Black puts on "Romeo and Juliet" in front of a student audience, but with so many deaths in the play, maybe one or two will be real.
episodes.title: Every Pretty Flower Has Its ___

episodes.synopsis: Another assassin tries her hand, but this one proposes a game with rules that will give Haru and Tokaku a chance to beat her fair and square.
episodes.title: What Can You Never Outrun?

episodes.synopsis: The field has been whittled to four assassins. With classes done and a typhoon closing in, Haru and Tokaku are in for a harrowing evening.
episodes.title: Which Gatekeeper Is the One Who Lies?

episodes.synopsis: Tokaku faces Isuke and her own inner demons, while Haru desperately tries to stay ahead of Shinya.
episodes.title: What Dwells in Your Heart? (Make-up Test)

episodes.synopsis: With Class Black down to four students, Tokaku and Haru face off against the person they consider to be their final opponent.
episodes.title: Who Is the Queen?

episodes.synopsis: The truth about Class Black is revealed, and Tokaku and Haru must grapple with the implications of this new information.
episodes.title: How to Distinguish a "Congratulation" from a "Curse"

episodes.synopsis: Now that Tokaku has delivered her advance notice, the three remaining members of Class Black have one last assassination attempt to sort out.
episodes.title: Therefore, the World Is Full of ____
